purpose: Define `#MEM` as the explicit registry of canonical memory records and memory-store interfaces, separating memory definition/data from model context and transient runtime caches.

topics.name: Memory Registry
topics.purpose: Define `#MEM` as the explicit registry of canonical memory records and memory-store interfaces, separating memory definition/data from model context and transient runtime caches.

semantics.registry_rule: Every machine-significant memory record is explicitly registered/addressable.
semantics.record_rule: Registry entries point to explicit Memory Record identities.
semantics.store_rule: Physical backing store is binding/implementation detail and does not define record identity.
semantics.model_rule: LLM/model hidden state and transient prompt context are not automatically canonical memory.
semantics.cache_rule: Runtime caches remain transient unless explicitly promoted through a memory write operation.
semantics.authority_rule: Registry membership does not grant read/write authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: hidden model state treated as canonical memory
physical store key/path used as sole memory identity
runtime cache silently promoted to canonical memory

prose.summary: Define `#MEM` as the explicit registry of canonical memory records and memory-store interfaces, separating memory definition/data from model context and transient runtime caches.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing memory/runtime contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
